title: Error reference
description: Request errors and conversion failure states.

sections.title: HTTP errors
table: file and to are required; invalid options JSON; invalid conversion controls
output not ready; job is running

sections.title: Job failures
paragraphs: A job can return HTTP 200 with status failed and an error field. Conversion diagnostics are intentionally not returned. Interrupted durable jobs report conversion_interrupted. Correct the input or underlying worker problem before resubmitting.

sections.title: Worker failure values
table: The worker could not complete the conversion, including timeout.
A durable job was running when the server restarted.

sections.title: Keep diagnostics separate from client responses
paragraphs: Detailed codec output can include paths or file metadata, so API responses deliberately return limited messages. Client applications should display a concise failure explanation and avoid logging uploads, names, or previews.

When investigating a failure, first reproduce it with a synthetic fixture on the server and check installed engine availability. A known-good small file helps distinguish an input problem from an installation problem.
